messages:
Rhea Patel: Hi everyone! I'm Rhea (she/her) — joining as a frontend engineer on the inference UI team. Starting today remote (PDT). Quick q's: I haven't received my MDM invite so I can't enroll my MacBook, and I don't have org GitHub access yet. Also need AWS staging role. Who's best to ping for infra creds and laptop enrollment? Two truths and a lie to break the ice: I ran a marathon, I'm allergic to chocolate, I once worked on a food truck.

John Alvarez: Welcome Rhea :wave: Great to have you. I added you to the team calendar and standup invite. For infra creds, please open a ticket in #it-support and @Samir will help with AWS. I'll DM you the onboarding checklist and access steps.

Samir Bose: hey @Rhea congrats! I can provision the staging role — can you drop your work email here? Also let's do a quick buddy sync at 2pm PT to walk through local dev and repo setup.

Rhea Patel: thanks Samir — email is rhea.patel@redwood.ai. 2pm PT works for me.

Devex Bot: Welcome Rhea! Quick links to get started: onboarding checklist: https://console.redwood.ai/onboarding, dev environment guide: https://docs.redwood.ai/dev-env. After cloning, run `scripts/setup.sh` and `yarn start`.

IT Support: Hi Rhea — sorry about the MDM hiccup. Can you open a ticket at help.redwood.ai/ticket and include your laptop serial number and preferred shipping address? We can also re-send the MDM invite if needed.

Kelsey - People Ops: Welcome aboard! Orientation is Thursday 10am PT (calendar invite sent). Swag pack has shipped — tracking 1Z9999999999999999. If any benefits forms are outstanding, check your inbox or ping me.

Marta Li: hi Rhea! Team lunch tomorrow at noon if you want to join (virtually). Also please join #eng-internal and #frontend for async convos.

Alex Kim: For GitHub, send me your handle and I'll add you to the `inference-ui` repo. Once invited, you can test SSH with `ssh -T git@github.com` — it should respond with 'Hi <handle>!' when it's working.

Rhea Patel: my GitHub handle is rhea-p. Ran the SSH test and got "Permission denied (publickey)" currently — will wait for the invite. Thanks everyone for the quick responses! :)

Samir Bose: I just added the staging AWS role for rhea.patel@redwood.ai — you should get console access in ~10 minutes. If not, reply here and I'll escalate.

John Alvarez: FYI our CODEOWNERS live under `infra/ownership`. For any repo-level approvals ping Alex. Also re: oncall access — we'll add you next week once infra confirms.

Devex Bot: Onboarding tracker update: step 'MDM enrolled' pending for Rhea Patel.

Rhea Patel: got the AWS email and the calendar invites. I'll open a ticket for MDM with IT Support now. Looking forward to meeting everyone in the sync at 2pm :smile:
